name: Payment soon after an unverified banking-detail change (from SYN-INC-001)
description: Derived from synthetic incident SYN-INC-001 to demonstrate the incident-to-rule workflow. Flags a payment to the same explicit vendor identifier within the policy window after a banking-detail change. The rule cannot see callback-verification records, so the reviewer must check them.
disclaimer: Derived from synthetic fixtures. It is not a pattern from any real or suppressed incident.

windowDays.rationale: Proposed: read the policy's 10 business days as 10 calendar days, which is narrower and produces fewer matches; awaiting reviewer decision.

first.description: A banking-detail change is recorded for the vendor

then.description: A payment to the same vendor identifier follows

window.description: The payment is within the policy window after the change (end inclusive)

benignExplanations: The change was verified by callback, but the callback record is held outside the imported data
A scheduled payment that the policy exempts
falsePositiveConsiderations: The rule cannot see callback verification, so verified changes still match
Change timestamps may be the approval time rather than the request time
